text: 【央行副行长陆磊：愿与东盟国家加强合作 共同研判人工智能技术衍生的新型金融风险】中国人民银行副行长陆磊18日在中国-东盟金融合作与发展论坛上围绕“深化中国与东盟金融领域人工智能合作”这一主题进行了讲话。陆磊表示，在中国实践中，我们始终坚持统筹发展与安全，引导金融机构稳妥有序推进人工智能应用，既充分激活其在海量数据处理、复杂模式识别、多模态内容生成方面的潜能，也充分发挥人在价值判断、伦理决策、创新创造等方面的核心优势，努力实现人工智能金融应用安全、可靠、可控。
text_en: [PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei: Willing to strengthen cooperation with ASEAN countries to jointly assess new financial risks arising from AI technology] Lu Lei, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China, spoke on 18th at the China-ASEAN Financial Cooperation and Development Forum on the theme of "deepening China-ASEAN cooperation in artificial intelligence in the financial sector." Lu Lei said that in China's practice, we have always adhered to coordinating development and security, guiding financial institutions to advance AI applications steadily and in an orderly manner, both fully activating its potential in massive data processing, complex pattern recognition, and multimodal content generation, and fully leveraging human core strengths in value judgment, ethical decision-making, and innovation and creativity, striving to achieve secure, reliable, and controllable AI financial applications.
